claim: In the matching retail DLL, three remaining Menu_SoundManager stop/reset methods form one exact family and all directly invoke already-canonical FACT-0125 AudioSrcInfo.Stop (0x060052C4). Stop_WrestlerVoice (0x060052B2), row c02f320000009600d2610a00e3a50000423d, RVA 0x00322FC0, signature 000001, is an exact 21-byte body with SHA-256 49e066c2b1ee1ab65086c2e443f5cb0f8cf3aa35b639aba7646ba87dc609e4c9: it selects audioSrcInfo[audio_source_index + 3], stores that AudioSrcInfo to local0, calls Stop(), and returns. Parameterless StopSE (0x060052B3), row e42f320000009600e5610a00e3a50000423d, RVA 0x00322FE4, signature 000001, is an exact 110-byte body with SHA-256 4706c335f4923a712dae0e35d839c427459c3268d2fd380435d7bb9bcdca0ff1: it loops raw i=0..7, skipping raw slots 0 and 1 and calling Stop() on audioSrcInfo[i] for raw slots 2..7; writes loopCheerVoiceFadeOutCnt=0 and loopCheerVoiceFadeOutFrm=0; then loops j=0 while j<SystemSEFileList.Length writing lockTimes[j]=0.0f; finally writes audio_source_index=0 and returns. StopSystemSE (0x060052B4), row 6030320000009600ec610a00e3a50000423d, RVA 0x00323060, signature 000001, is an exact 57-byte body with SHA-256 0af8b0fc25dd48cd0572ac0c664bf58267f9ef3a3fcb6dae9e3eaaa76ab37bd8: it calls Stop() on audioSrcInfo[1], loops over SystemSEFileList.Length writing lockTimes[j]=0.0f, writes audio_source_index=0, and returns. None has an exception section. Their inbound direct DLL references are retained as raw caller observations only because those caller bodies are outside this fact.
